question: How Can Corruption In The Philippines Be Fixed?

answers.text: -Do you think the Philippines has a corruption problem? Oh, definitely. That's not even a question. That's a fact now -How can it be fixed? We have to be tighter on the rules because people are feeling like they have the power, so they're abusing it and they're using other people's weaknesses, like their need for money to continue conducting these misconducts
Vote wisely -Which party/person is the wise party/person? Panfilo “Ping” Lacson
because I definitely think that there should be more power to the youth

It's not really focusing too much on the party but trying to focus on the politicians themsleves and what change they can bring about -Do you have any politicians or leaders that you like to listen to? My hopeful back in the previous presidential election was Leni Robredo. She really has, a structured plan
I'm really pro-Leni Robredo I was really disappointed when she was defeated I’m still rooting for her if she ever decide to run again
I can't think of anyone. Only a percentage is [only] 1% are really serious
Mr. Vico Soto is known for his leadership and his service for the Pasig community Because there is literally zero corruption in Pasig right now.

The corruption here is really systematic So even from the lowest level of government, there is corruption and even up to the highest. Fake news is, also a big problem here in the Philippines since a lot of people in the Philippines are glued to social media, so they're really prone to fake news

Filipinos would vote for names that they know rather than people they know would be in a better, I think, a better fit for the position. So, for example, some actors run for Senate when they don't have the qualifications for it There should be transparency, especially in government projects

and you're definitely affecting so much more than just the corrupt politicians I think it certainly has to be with the people first, because look at the poor voting That's certainly our first problem, you know, like, why are we doing this to ourselves?
the people fought against corruption, but it didn't change, you know. Have you heard about the song“(I Can't Get No) Satisfaction”
If you...get what you like... If you...get what you like... you’ll try to get to the next level[politicians]
